source_analysis: List definitions, theorem assumptions, proofs, methods and example dependencies, retaining source references.
lesson_planning: Keep multistep proofs and worked examples coherent across planned lesson parts; allow extra time for nontrivial reasoning.
slides: Preserve exact notation and hypotheses; show complete, legible derivation steps and avoid splitting a single essential equation.
narration: Explain what each mathematical expression means in ordinary speech, disambiguate letters and never assert an unproved step.
highlighting: Highlight the whole relevant equation, transformation or proof line at the time it is explained, not an unrelated nearby symbol.
quality_review: Flag invalid inferences, missing assumptions, incorrect identities and dropped proof steps for review.
